name: Azure Monitor
sku: Azure Monitor, the platform-wide observability service. It watches Azure resources, applications and infrastructure; it does not check whether data is fresh or correct. It monitors Azure resources across every service, so the scope is the whole spine.

bands.note: Microsoft's unified observability service: it collects logs and metrics from every Azure service, analyses them with Log Analytics and metrics explorer, visualises them in workbooks, and alerts on them with dynamic thresholds.

presentation.tagline: Metrics, logs, alerts and dashboards across Azure services.
